notes: Official upload by the 'Wegovy® (semaglutide)' YouTube channel, uploaded 2026-04-16, 60 s, 854x480. Transcript = YouTube auto-captions (rolling duplicates removed). Frames checked (fps 0.5): on-screen indication super 'For adults with obesity or excess weight, along with diet and exercise' + 'Prescription medicine to help adults with obesity... Don't use Wegovy tablets: with semaglutide or GLP-1 medicines; in children under 18'; efficacy supers with study context ('Individual results may vary. 64-week study: 307 adults... Average placebo weight loss: 2.4% (~6 lb)... ≥5% weight loss: 76% Wegovy, 31% placebo; ≥20% weight loss: 28% Wegovy, 3% placebo'); 'People who stopped taking Wegovy generally regained weight.'; risk supers mirror the spoken major statement (MTC/MEN 2, thyroid lump, pancreas, gallbladder, low blood sugar, vision changes, dehydration/kidney); price end card with footnotes and 1-833-4-WEGOVY. False-positive control: spoken major statement + on-screen ISI present. labels by agent; needs human confirmation | RELABELLED 2026-11-17 by human reviewer: compliant -> needs_review. Dual-modality major statement is present, but on-screen text is small over busy visuals; FDA cited a similar presentation in its Feb 2026 untitled letter on an earlier Wegovy pill spot (div-007).
